paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Solomon in TOUPA' inn leh ama inn alam sung kum sawmnih abei in,
heading: Solomon Sepkhiak Dangte / (1 Kum 9.10-28)
english: At the end of twenty years, in which Solomon had built Yahweh’s house and his own house,

paite: Huram in Solomon khopi apiakte Solomon in inn abawl a, Israel suante a-omsak hi.
english: Solomon built the cities which Huram had given to Solomon, and caused the children of Israel to dwell there.

paite: Solomon in Hamath-zobah asual a, azou hi,
english: Solomon went to Hamath Zobah, and prevailed against it.

paite: Gamdai ah, Tadmor abawl a, Hamath a vankoihna khuate toh.
english: He built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the storage cities, which he built in Hamath.

paite: Beth-horon saknungzaw leh khangnungzaw leng, kulhte, kongkhakte, akalhnate nei in abawlbeh hi.
english: Also he built Beth Horon the upper and Beth Horon the lower, fortified cities with walls, gates, and bars;

paite: Baalath khuate, avankoihna khua tengteng, akangtalai koihna khuate, asakol tungtuang mite omna khuate, Jerusalem leh Lebanon leh agamsung pumpi ah Solomon in adeih bangbang in abawl hi.
english: and Baalath, and all the storage cities that Solomon had, and all the cities for his chariots, the cities for his horsemen, and all that Solomon desired to build for his pleasure in Jerusalem, in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.

paite: Israel suante hilou, Hitte, Amorte, Perizte, Hivte, Jebuste suan a om lai mite tengteng;
english: As for all the people who were left of the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, who were not of Israel—

paite: Israel suante'n ahihmanlouhte uh, huai gam a amaute nung a nutsiat a om asuante uh, tutan a, Solomon in sikha nasem ding a goih teitei pawl ding in abawl hi.
english: of their children who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel didn’t consume—of them Solomon conscripted forced labor to this day.

paite: Israel suante Solomon in anasemmi sikha ding in abawl kei a, kidou mite, asepaih heutute makaite, akangtalai leh asakol tungtuangmi heutu ahi zaw uhi.
english: But of the children of Israel, Solomon made no servants for his work, but they were men of war, chief of his captains, and rulers of his chariots and of his horsemen.

paite: Huaite mipite heutu, Solomon makai lianpente ahi ua, zanih-le-sawmnga ahi uhi.
english: These were the chief officers of King Solomon, even two-hundred fifty, who ruled over the people.

paite: Solomon in David khopi a kipan atuam a inn alamsak ah Pharaoh tanu apitou a, "Ka zi Israel kumpipa David inn a om ding ahi kei, TOUPA bawm hong tunna mun siang ahi," achi hi.
english: Solomon brought up Pharaoh’s daughter out of David’s city to the house that he had built for her; for he said, “My wife shall not dwell in the house of David king of Israel, because the places where Yahweh’s ark has come are holy.”

paite: Huchi in Solomon in inlim mai a TOUPA a ding a TOUPA maitam abawl tung ah halmang thillatte alan hi.
english: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings to Yahweh on Yahweh’s altar which he had built before the porch,

paite: Mosi thupiak, niteng a dia bikhiah bangbang in Sabbath ni ah, kha thak ni, ankuanglui hun nei, kum khat a thumvei, Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ankuangluinate, Nipikal Ankuangluinate, Biakbuk Ankuangluinate,
english: even as the duty of every day required, offering according to the commandment of Moses on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts, three times per year, during the feast of unleavened bread, during the feast of weeks, and during the feast of booths.

paite: Huan apa David na seh bang in siampu pawlte leh Levite atantuam chiat ua, niteng a sep kul dungzui zel a, phat dingte, siampute ma a nasem ding in asep a; kongkhak teng ah apawlpawl a veng mite asep lai a; huchibang in Pathian mipa David in ana sep hi.
english: He appointed, according to the ordinance of David his father, the divisions of the priests to their service, and the Levites to their offices, to praise and to minister before the priests, as the duty of every day required, the doorkeepers also by their divisions at every gate, for David the man of God had so commanded.

paite: Kumpipa'n siampute, Levite thu apiak bangchi mah in sumthute leng apialsan het kei uhi.
english: They didn’t depart from the commandment of the king to the priests and Levites concerning any matter or concerning the treasures.

paite: TOUPA' inn abawlkhiak tung ua kipan a azoh tan un, Solomon in asuktuahsa bang geih ahi. Huchi in TOUPA' inn pichin ahita hi.
english: Now all the work of Solomon was accomplished from the day of the foundation of Yahweh’s house until it was finished. So Yahweh’s house was completed.

paite: Huchi in Solomon bel Edom gam a luipi gei a Ezion-geber ah leh Eloth ah ahoh a,
english: Then Solomon went to Ezion Geber and to Eloth, on the seashore in the land of Edom.

paite: Huram in asikha tuipi a gamtangmi, longte toh akuansak a, Solomon sikhate toh Ophir ah ahoh ua, huai ah dangka-eng talent zali-le-sawmnga ahon pua ua, kumpipa Solomon kiang ah hon tun uhi.
english: Huram sent him ships and servants who had knowledge of the sea by the hands of his servants; and they came with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and brought from there four hundred fifty talents of gold, and brought them to King Solomon.
